content.rationale: The validate verb: it reads the node set through M-node-set — each node's document and edges, or its load failure, read through M-store-read across the runner (M-jj) — checks node validity from those load outcomes, resolves every edge target exactly as the graph resolves it (M-node-resolve), and computes sandwich coverage over the loaded edges (D9, kwwsoosw), reporting each failure as one `<check> <id> <reason>` line (O10) and changing nothing, recording no verdicts; an argument refuses (C). It returns its lines for the envelope to write (M-output-return) under M-route's handler shape, carrying its own --help text (xlvoxmyl/rwlywqrk) and the injected context (M-context-injection). I1-serde (`orrvsxqq`) fixes the JSON layer the module is written against — serde and serde_json, the crate's own `Value` and the derive. It takes the runner from the injected context (M-context). The read's refusal site (S2-read-refusal-site, vollyzvn) is this invocation's: an unreadable node is a reported validity line, never a silent skip.
